newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech builder Metrostav 1996 profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Czech builder Metrostav 1996 profits rise.

text.p: The Czech construction company Metrostav a.s. said on Tuesday that preliminary results showed 1996 net profit rose to 93 million crowns from 72 million in the previous year.

Vladimir Veverka, director of the company's department for internal matters, said total turnover rose to 5.8 billion crowns from 5.1 billion. No further results were available, and all 1996 results are still subject to an audit.
The company added that current shareholders took 129,000 shares out of a rights issue offering 150,000 ordinary shares in January, at 1,500 crowns per share.
A second round, offering the remaining 31,000 shares to only those who participated in the first round at the same price, will be launched on February 13.
